aliases: Fairy Xue Er Lady Xue Er Snowman Xue Er

summary.text: Xue Er is a rank six snowman Gu Immortal of the snowman tribe under Northern Plains' northern icy plain. She finds Fang Yuan inside the battlefield killer move grey cloud battle puppet.

claims.text: Frost condenses on Fang Yuan’s original spot and forms thick ice the size of a pavilion. A rank six Gu Immortal speaks in the same female voice that found him. A rank seven praises Xue Er. She thanks her great-grandma: she cannot break his disguise, but every time he activates the killer move to create phantoms the aura leaks, and as the frequency rises she discovers him.
The rank six Gu Immortal called Xue Er confirms that the upper extreme heavenly eagle is real and that its vitality is extremely flourishing.

At the underground feast she walks over to Fang Yuan, takes up the work of a servant, and pours ice wolf wine. He asks if she is the snowman who discovered his true body. She says she is only good at some investigative methods. She introduces Bing Zhuo as the strongest in their tribe.

At Earth Mother Altar she giggles that Fang Yuan will know why there is earth and soil below the northern icy plain once he enters. She asks whether Old Ancestor Xue Hu will succeed in refining fortune rivalling heaven Gu.
She is a beautiful female snowman Gu Immortal. The female snowman lowers her head and gives a coy smile. Her face is red, she lowers her head and acts shy, and she takes sneaky glances.

When Fang Yuan joins the four races alliance, the smile on Xue Er becomes even more lovely. She asks him to stay another day or two. Seeing he is intent on leaving, she lowers her head, then raises it and hands him an item in her hand as a farewell gift: an ice tear drop.

To snowmen an ice tear is a token of love, often exchanged at marriage. She tells him not to look at it like that and to place it down. She lowers her head, her face flushing red with shyness. When he thanks her and talks of refining it into a Gu worm, the shy redness leaves, replaced by pale white, and tears start to form. She is young and beautiful, her talent outstanding and her cultivation high. She has had the attention and favor of the tribe, and there is no man in the same generation worthy of her.
Bing Yuan calls Xue Er her granddaughter, a Gu Immortal of incredible looks, and plans to marry her to Fang Yuan so the snowman tribe is no longer bullied by the rockmen.

She is young and beautiful, tall and vibrant, with blue eyes and hair, and the icy trait of her variant human race. She has tender skin and a plump chest. She is the number one beauty of the snowman tribe.

Bing Zhuo toasts Lord Fang Yuan and Fairy Xue Er. Xue Er sits close beside Fang Yuan with an uneasy expression. Bing Yuan is the grandmother of Xue Er and the one who initiated and planned the marriage. The banquet is an engagement ceremony, not a wedding.

After Fang Yuan takes Immortal Gu, Xue Er’s body shakes: her Immortal Gu is gone. She looks at him in disbelief. Variant human Gu Immortals die one after another until only she is left. She says she will not let him off even as a ghost. Yama children tear her into pieces of shredded meat. Her soul is preserved in yama battlefield and imprisoned.
Xue Er is at Lang Ya blessed land. Fang Yuan gives her a nod and leaves, which excites the snowman Gu Immortals.

The female immortal is young and beautiful, tall and vibrant, with blue eyes and hair, and the icy trait of her variant human race. Fang Yuan’s time path clone has the same cultivation level as her at rank six. The snowman tribe lives in his sovereign immortal aperture, and her grandmother Bing Yuan has become his subordinate. He makes Xue Er the owner of snow crystal formation and tells her to take care of the tribe. When he holds her, her face is flushed red.
Xue Er, Bing Zhuo, and others are not given future self. In the previous life Fang Yuan had already killed them, so they did not exist in the lower stream of the River of Time and had no future.

Under her command the snowman tribe quadruples. A female snowman rank five Gu Master calls her supreme elder. She works at the tribe’s development with snow crystal formation and comes in person to manipulate the formation when frost qi surges.

At Inkman City, a snowman female immortal is tall and vibrant, has blue eyes and hair, and looks pure and noble: Xue Er. On the surface her identity is Fang Yuan’s fiancée. He has never acknowledged it and has not denied it. Bing Yuan trumpets the relationship. Xue Er and Bing Yuan will activate ice and snow killer moves to freeze and slow the growth of vegetation.

Triple Sacred Mountain is the center of Mini Northern Plains, the gathering area of snowmen, and is looked after by Fang Yuan’s fiancée, Xue Er. Sacred Eagle City Lord has faith in Fairy Xue Er’s help.
